component.name: Glyphkeel
component.summary: Plan and track tasks on your own computer

description.p: Glyphkeel is a task manager for one person on one computer. It keeps every task, wiki page and attachment in a folder on your disk, needs no account and never connects to the network.

ul.li: Projects with sub-projects, each with its own statuses, types and labels
Boards, lists with a query language, and a Today view
Markdown descriptions with checklists, math and diagrams
Comments, attachments, time tracking and reminders
A command line, glyphkeel, and a built-in MCP server for coding agents, with a history of every change that can be undone

screenshot.caption: A project board with its columns of task cards
A task open beside the board, with its checklist, subtasks and links
The tasks of a project as a list
Today, the tasks for the day
A wiki page of a project

description.p: Sprints with planning and burndown, automation rules, dashboards, card colours and covers, encrypted workspaces and an app lock, and for agents: confirmations, watching tasks and an optional local HTTP endpoint.

Hardening for 1.0: a security review with limits on agents' file paths, accessibility fixes in every theme, much faster CSV import, boards and schedules, translatable messages throughout, an About page with third-party notices, an Arch package and signed APT and DNF repositories, column width reset, and new task shortcuts.
Custom fields, versions and a roadmap, status and agent rules, recurring tasks and templates, CSV import with Jira and Redmine presets, flow reports, history in queries, and prompts for agents.
Windows support: an installer for the current user, Windows notifications, links and dialogs, starting with Windows, and portable file names in exports.
A wiki with links, backlinks, page moves, files, templates, macros, export and folder import; a Gantt chart with dependencies and moving dependents; a calendar; and a fuller time report.

First public release: tasks on a board and in a list, a query language and saved views, search, wiki, time tracking, trash, backups, export and import, an activity feed, and a command line and agent server.
Early development build: activity feed, trash, backups, and export and import.
